measurement_basis: committed baseline inspection and authenticated project-owner audit sources

outcome.baseline_projection_capability: The existing implementation-accountability projection exposed repository-owner audit summaries, source references, and plain host-responsibility labels. It did not project the verified audit records' structured responsibility classifications, stated eliminating capabilities, entrypoints, verification-plan boundaries, or exact remaining host paths.
outcome.source_evidence: Two immutable owner-audit pointers in the campaign's cross-project native-userland observation identify exact native-userland-audit.json blobs for mncs-actions and mncs-test. Their classifications and proposed capabilities remain repository-owner declarations.
outcome.actionable_opportunity: Read only the exact allowlisted audit records after content-integrity verification under existing selected-checkout or workspace-read-only authority, then expose bounded source details through the existing projection.
outcome.recurrence: One campaign evidence path; repeated agent difficulty or cross-session recurrence is not established.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Native owner-audit capability dependencies were hidden behind summary strings
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: Environment implementation accountability and native-userland projection
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The committed 78471a baseline projects owner-audit counts, summaries, and plain host-responsibility strings. The authenticated campaign observation references exact owner audit files containing more specific classifications, eliminating-capability statements, verification-plan details, and host paths. This establishes a projection coverage gap, not failed discovery by another agent or independently verified implementation ownership.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Extend the existing bounded projection to parse only the exact allowlisted audit schema after hash verification under established repository read authority; expose source details and preserve owner-declared, not independently verified status.
